title: Gift shop in Seattle (no construction)
assumptions: The company already exists (Pike Keepsakes LLC). Hires staff. Moves into a space that needs no construction. Puts up an exterior sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Washington State Business License (Business Licensing Service)
items.agency: Washington Department of Revenue, Business Licensing Service

items.name: Unemployment insurance and workers' comp accounts (opened through the business license)
items.agency: Washington ESD and L&I (through the Business Licensing Service)
items.note: ESD and L&I "automatically create your State Unemployment Insurance (SUI) and Workers Compensation (WC) accounts" from the business license application.

items.name: Seattle business license tax certificate
items.agency: City of Seattle, License and Tax Administration
items.feeNote: 2026 tier 1 (under $20,000 taxable revenue); new applicants generally pay tier 1 the first year.

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
mustNotInclude.why: A store that sells no food needs no food permit.
